must_do: inventory global, CLI, and current task plugin state
show selectable plugins as native checkboxes when visualize is available
precheck all selectable plugins on first use

must_do: treat the submitted selection as the one apply confirmation
regenerate live inventory and run fail-closed profile plan/preflight internally
apply app default-deny plus canonical selected and excluded app IDs
conditionally apply a transaction that runtime-verifies Apps, Skills, and MCP with Desktop checked first
rollback the two managed files and report structured evidence on any runtime mismatch

write enabled true for selected plugins
call a file-only result valid when runtime enforcement fails
claim a security boundary or universal project allowlist

write default-deny app policy and explicit false for excluded IDs
runtime-verify app enabled and callable state

claim provenance isolation for shared app IDs

must_do: offer a grouped numbered multi-select fallback
must_not_do: stop solely because visualize is unavailable

rerun the runtime app, skill, and MCP gate against Desktop then distinct PATH Codex
report success only as runtime verified

alter files when validation finds a runtime mismatch
